pr_title: i2s: add i2s support for NXP imxrt10xx platform
pr_body:

2. enable i2s on mimxrt1060_evk to demo
2. tested on tests/drivers/i2s/i2s_api and i2s_speed


Fixes #32037

issue_context.title: Implement an I2S / SAI (shim) driver for NXP IMX-RT1060 (mcux).
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
I would like to develop an application which can play / receive audio via the SAI1 peripheral (by means of eDMA) of the NXP IMX-RT1060 MCU using the board IMXRT1060-EVK (and its I2C controlled codec WM8960).

**Describe the solution you'd like**
I simply like to use the Zephyr I2S API for getting audio sending and audio receiving to work at the SAI1 interface. I guess a shim driver for the exisiting [NXP HAL driver `fsl_sai.c` and `fsl_sai_edma.c` ](https://github.com/NXPmicro/hal_nxp/tree/master/mcux/drivers/imx) has to be developped.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
I tried to use the NXP HAL drivers functions from `fsl_sai.h` and `fsl_sai_edma.h` directly... still without success.

**Additional context**
Codec driver for WM8960 (also missing for Zephyr).
